evidence: p595 (psalter wk II, Feria II [DB wkday 2], image confirmed): Off. lect. H, 'Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane: Ipsum nunc nobis (LHym 217)' then 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore: Vita sanctorum (LHym 217)'. Held option 1 gregobase:4615 = Ipsum nunc (noctu); this row's gregobase:16745 Vita sanctorum is the diurno alternative; both printed with LHym 217. p8 (Advent, 'Pro cunctis diebus') does not print Vita sanctorum at all (Verbum supernum LHym 5, Vox clara 6, Nunc Sancte 7 ...): the body-link citation to p8 is spurious; the only body page printing it is p595 (hymn index p1224 lists it).
